verdict.line: You lose if his E (Death's Grasp) catches you mid-animation and chains into Q (Obliterate) before you can shield; you win if you force the first stun with W (Path Maker), since he has nothing to escape it with.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has zero mobility outside of E (Death's Grasp) — no dash, no blink, nothing that lets him leave melee range once he's committed. K'Sante's whole kit is built to punish exactly that: the 2-stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) shockwave pulls him in, and W (Path Maker) stuns him on the spot, and he cannot walk out of either. The 49% head-to-head over 1,844 games reflects that his pull-into-burst (E into Q) wins the fight if it lands first, but the data's lane-advantage and solo-kill-advantage edges both belong to you because once your stun connects, he's stuck.

theirWindow.when: when his E (Death's Grasp) is up
theirWindow.what: He pulls you in with E then lands Q (Obliterate) and autos to stack Darkness Rise. Expect a burst of bonus magic damage and move speed right after the third hit lands.

yourWindow.when: when his E (Death's Grasp) is down
yourWindow.what: He has no dash or blink to disengage, so charge W (Path Maker) into him, land the knockback-stun, and chain Q (Ntofo Strikes) autos while he's stuck in melee range.

start.why: Mordekaiser's whole early game is magic poke from Q (Obliterate) and autos; Doran's Helm's sustain and magic damage reduction holds the lane through those trades.

boots.why: His damage is 100% magic, and the tenacity matters once he starts chaining E (Death's Grasp) pulls into stuns from allies.

core.why: A flat magic shield that recharges is the single best answer to a melee magic-damage laner who lives on repeated Q and auto trades.
Gives you the AoE slow and extra trade damage to back up Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacking and W (Path Maker) engages.
Stacking resistances rewards the long trades this lane turns into once both W and E cooldowns are down.

situational.when: his Indestructible (W) shield-heal is undoing your damage in extended trades
he's hitting Darkness Rise procs and auto-trading you down early
you're already ahead and want a cheaper, faster defensive item to keep the lead

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the auto-trade pattern this lane forces and gives sustained health against his magic poke, which pure damage keystones can't match here.

summoners.why: Teleport is the standard pick (76.2% pick rate) for scaling and wave management into a melee matchup with no all-in pressure before level 6. Flash+Ignite (49.2% win rate) is a viable alternative if you want to press the solo-kill advantage directly.

playing.title: Bait his E before engaging
playing.detail: Make him whiff Death's Grasp (cd 16/14/12/10/8s) by holding max range in early trades; once it's down he has no other gap-closer, so you can walk up safely and start the fight on your terms.

playing.title: Stack Q before W stun
playing.detail: Land Ntofo Strikes (Q) twice to trigger the 2-stack shockwave pull, then immediately follow with the charge-up on Path Maker (W) for a stun he cannot walk out of.

playing.title: Respect level 6 isolation
playing.detail: Once he hits Realm of Death (R, cd 140/120/100/90/80s), any all-in drags you into a 1v1 pocket with no outside help; don't commit to extended trades right as his ultimate comes off cooldown unless you're clearly ahead.

playing.title: Track his Indestructible charges
playing.detail: Indestructible (W, cd 12/11/10/9/8s) banks a shield from damage dealt and taken; trade in short bursts so he can't stack a big one off a long fight, and finish extended trades only after it's down.

playing.title: Deny his passive stacks
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after he lands 3 attacks or spells on you, giving him a damage aura and move speed; use Footwork (E) to reset range instead of standing in repeated Obliterate (Q) hits.

playing.title: Time All Out with your stun
playing.detail: All Out (R) knocks him through terrain and drops your defenses in exchange for damage; pop it right as your W (Path Maker) stun or Q shockwave lands so he can't Indestructible-shield through the burst.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, and summoner spells here are pulled directly from measured K'Sante vs Mordekaiser games on the current patch (1,844 games, 49% K'Sante win rate); the trade-pattern and timing reads are my own analysis of the kit, not sourced from the data.
